verdict: PASS five unissued concrete-material prompts and mandatory relief-gate plan; generated-art acceptance pending
scope: Only five material-v2 prompts; used006/104/096 requests and raw outputs are not changed or reattributed.

materials.name: rtex306
materials.materialInterpretation: Weathered dark sandstone architectural frame surrounding a recessed grey-green slate panel.
materials.basis: Weathered dark sandstone frame with slightly recessed grey-green slate centre is a plausible physical interpretation of the native dark nested panel. Fine chisel/fracture cues and coherent slate lamination make the finish concrete without new joints or ornaments. Exact frame widths/offsets/centre shape and no new outerbevel are explicit.
materials.requiredGate: Classify actual centre/frame witnesses before tiers: centre below frame, not a deep hole/protrudingjewel. Fine lamination/chisel wear must remain subordinate; no broad new stripes or fracture motifs.

materials.name: ttex054
materials.materialInterpretation: Aged lime-plaster wall with matte mineral pigments and painted red/ochre meander trim.
materials.basis: Aged matte lime plaster/mineral pigment is a concrete plausible wall interpretation. The greenupper/redlowerfields and angular meander remain painted marks. Xperiod, band heights, tiny motif spacing, corner intersections and distinct Yends are explicit; forcedYblend is forbidden.
materials.requiredGate: Before tiers verify plaster microrelief without embossing pigment/meander strokes. Defaultpainted profile is not semantic proof. Preserve original Yband identities; do not use a boundary blend to erase them.

materials.name: ttex012
materials.materialInterpretation: Dry dressed ochre sandstone masonry with recessed dark lime mortar.
materials.basis: Dry dressed ochre sandstone/dark recessed lime mortar coherently interprets the native warm coursed masonry. Exact course/offset/block/edge shapes and narrowjointnetwork retained; quiet faces/sparsepores counter uniformgrain.
materials.requiredGate: Confirm source course/edge continuity and jointcentres below faces before tiers. Dressedstone cues must not add smaller bricks, larger chips or wider bevels.

materials.name: rpal317
materials.materialInterpretation: Very dark basalt with narrow weathered mineral fracture interfaces.
materials.basis: Matte charcoal-blue basalt with restrained smoky fracture interfaces is a plausible explicit interpretation, recorded as uncertain historical geology. Broad darkmasses and narrow network scale are preserved; brightveins/openfissures/newpebbles are forbidden.
materials.requiredGate: Reject an actual source that still reads as indeterminate granularnoise despite the basalt label. Fine facets/pores must make coherent basalt surfaces without changing networkwidth or darkpalette.

materials.name: ttex153
materials.materialInterpretation: Weathered pale sandy limestone blocks with pale recessed lime mortar.
materials.basis: Weathered pale sandy limestone/pale recessed lime mortar preserves mixedblocks, offsets, clippededges, palejointcolour and fine darkjointcentres. Concrete limestone cues are restrained; no raisedcaulking or palette-darkening shortcut.
materials.requiredGate: Independently classify real stonefaces vs palejointcentres before tiers. BrightRGB does not establish height. If tonalheight fails, source/master-only proof and reviewed semantic correction precede encoding; no copied foreignmask/depthvalues.

realMaterialGate: Actual raw must visibly read as its selected sandstone/slate, limeplaster, sandstone, basalt or limestone without relying on a label. Pixel count, sharpness, similarity scores and the wordphotographic are insufficient; noisy/abstract/syntheticgrain remainsHOLD before master/tier work.

preTierReliefGates.rtex306: Independently classify actual inset/frame witnesses and inspect opposed lights before either tier. Preserve intended shallowrecess and no extra geometry.
preTierReliefGates.ttex054: Before either tier, check plaster surface relief independently of paintedmeander/colourband brightness. Paint is pigment, not carved/embossed ornament. If tonalcraft introduces emboss, keepHOLD until a source-specific reviewed physical-relief plan is qualified; no automatic repair prescribed by this prompt review.
preTierReliefGates.ttex153: Independent stoneface/palejointcentre sampling before either tier. If tonalheight fails, qualify actual source/master-only proof with nativeIdentity/name/edition/exactMPpathSHA; then use a reviewed source-specific semantic recipe without RGB palette change or guard weakening.

sharedSourceTierContract: One retained adequate>=8x/aspect source and oneactive RGB/fullprecision scalar master; unchangedLow, defaultMid4x/High8x directfromsame master, allenhancedmaps lossyWebP92method6. Matchingnormals from uncompressedscalar; no separatelygeneratedtiers or model-authorednormalmaps.
edgeAndFidelityGates: Both native and decodedreplacement use sameBOX atnativehalf/quarter; actual1:1/decodedtiers/repeats/corners/opposedlights remain mandatory. Preserve shapes/feature scale and nativeedge relationships; no extraedgebricks/perimeterbevels/uniformnoise/sharpening.
